sonicScene.thesis: Talking Heads: pale porcelain mannequin busts, each speaking its own channel like a noise gate -- on a note its neck snaps back, its lips part and rays of light shoot from its mouth; between notes they seal and look round the room, eyes darting ahead of each turn.

composition.background: a near-black indigo to deep violet gradient with a faint blue-purple haze
composition.midground: three busts well apart in the dark, at different headings, among drifting mist
composition.foreground: sparse slow motes at three depths
secondary: the mouth rays sweeping the room
each head's own shake, tear, ghosts and wash, in its own palette
composition.atmosphere: dark, suspended; drifting mist lit by the speaking heads; no floor, horizon or set
composition.post: a restrained bloom; no screen-wide glitch (every tear is a head's own)
composition.camera: a slow, restrained drift; never on the music

palette.saturation: pale porcelain against saturated emitted light

medium: the scans and the neck's looks: pans, pauses, snaps
fast: the gates: the neck snaps, the lips part, the rays with the mouth
extremely_fast: a head's own tear on an opening

vocabulary: with no stems: each head on the mix's band, rate-limited
the heads are shut and scan the room
sonicScene.tier: light: three articulated busts (about 45k triangles each), rays and copies only on a speaking head
sonicScene.title: Talking Heads
